acceptanceCriteria: Quoted > characters in HTML attributes are removed with their tag; unterminated script/style bodies are dropped through EOF, with search/full-import regression coverage.
An unresolved suite is refused even when the suites inventory is empty; suite/section joins cannot silently drop missing context.
Legacy case digest decoding refuses duplicate object members and trailing non-whitespace or a second JSON value without partial stale evidence.
The --legacy-cases reader refuses FIFO/device/nonregular input promptly and binds validation to the opened descriptor.
Keep existing legacy ledger/payload bytes and CLI/MCP search receipt identity unchanged; focused tests and independent review pass.
